notes: (02/11) Discovery call w/ Head of Search (Mark H.) + CTO (Priya R.). Primary ask: replace brittle keyword search across legacy ECM with retrieval-augmented ranking using embeddings + reranker.
They expect ~100M+ 'text objects' after chunking (legal filings, M&A docs, contracts). Concerned about index sharding and cold-start latency when serving long-tail corpora.

Scale targets: steady-state QPS 200-500 (peak 2k for bursts), target p50 end-to-end 40-80ms for vector ANN fetch + rerank, p95 < 350ms for baseline queries. Cost goal: <$0.01/query (embedding+ANN+rerank amortized).
Preferred vector embedding dim: 1536 (their current in-house infra uses OpenAI-like dims). Open to switching to smaller dims if cost/latency tradeoff clear.

Connector wishlist (explicit from infra architect): bulk upsert >10k/sec, idempotent incremental imports, per-namespace ACLs, metadata/boolean filters at index-time and query-time, hybrid search (BM25 + ANN) fallback, vector TTL and tombstone handling, nearline reindex pipeline, backpressure handling for streaming ingestion.

Model routing: want primary cheap embedding model for indexing (hosted) + higher-quality embedding for reindexing hot docs. Reranker: prefer cross-encoder rerank hosted in Dedicated to avoid extra roundtrip latency to external APIs.

Security: must have SSO (SAML/Okta), audit logs for every vector upsert and query, customer-managed KMS, EU data residency for EU clients. Also asked about encryption-in-transit and at-rest for private deploy.

requirements_summary: Index scale: target 100M+ vectors, incremental daily ingest ~5-10M vectors
Latency SLOs: p50 40-80ms; p95 <350ms including rerank for 99% of production queries
Cost sensitivity: target <$0.01 per user query (including embedding amortization and reranker token costs)
Vector DB features required: bulk upsert, namespace isolation, metadata filters, hybrid search support, snapshot/export, low-latency ANN, configurable replication/consistency
Connector requirements: streaming ingest with backpressure, idempotent retries, schema mapping for metadata, incremental reindex API, monitoring metrics (ingest QPS, index latency, disk usage)
Security/compliance: SAML SSO, SOC2/ISO27001 evidence, audit logs for queries/upserts, customer-managed KMS, EU data residency options
Model preferences: open to open-source embeddings for indexing; want higher-quality encoder for reranking (cross-encoder) hosted in Dedicated
Fallbacks: BM25 fallback plan + model variant routing to preserve availability during capacity constraints
